text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship left a brilliant mark in the 
Satsuki Sho, successfully avenging her 
loss from April. She's already all fired 
up, claiming next year's Satsuki Sho is as 
good as hers too.

Little does Gold Ship know, however, that 
she won't be able to enter the Satsuki Sho 
next year... Even so, keep on running, 
Gold Shiiiip!
